name: amazon-us
description: Claude Code plugin: Amazon.com marketplace research — verified price, stock, rating, seller and specs from the listing rather than the search grid; Prime-aware delivery dates checked against the ZIP they were actually rendered for; filtered signed-in search with tested extractors, a marketplace profile and a durable brand allowlist. Works around the fact that the default fetch tool cannot reach Amazon and that every fallback route fails in a way that resembles success.
